correctness.rationale: The proof uses the graph-specific equivalence between gradient vector fields and acyclic partial orientations. Two independent exhaustive constructions agree on all 98 nonempty faces and face vector (10,33,40,15). The full 246-cover Hasse diagram supports a verified acyclic 48-pair matching with exactly one critical 0-cell and one critical 2-cell; Forman theory therefore gives a CW complex consisting of a point and one 2-cell attached to it, hence a two-sphere. Boundary ranks over F_2, F_3, F_5, and F_7 all give Betti vector (1,0,1,0) as an independent check.

value.rationale: The bull graph is the smallest named configuration obtained by putting two leaves on distinct vertices of a triangle, and it sits directly across the hypothesis boundary of the published theorem that two leaves sharing one support make the Morse complex contractible. The exact two-sphere result shows that leaf placement, not merely leaf count, changes the topology; it also contrasts with the published contractible one-leaf triangle case. This is a motivated boundary example rather than an arbitrary finite slice.
